name: application-08
title: Chat with run details
description: A Quenby chat with run details: chats grouped by day with a search, a sidebar that collapses and goes into a sheet on phones, a thread where the assistant thinks, asks before it reads a shared file and cites numbered sources that light up, a model picker, Send that becomes Stop, and a details panel from the header whose plan, calls, tokens and cost move as the run goes. Plug your assistant into onSend, onApprove, onDeny and onStop.
